name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber PCTG @base
filament_notes:
High Impact (gray, ~20% stronger / 115% stiffer than unfilled PCTG) and High Strength (black, ~45% stronger / 250% stiffer) carbon-fiber PCTG.
Proto-Pasta publishes no numeric settings for this line; PCTG-family defaults applied. Hardened nozzle and gears required (abrasive). Use Magigoo or glue stick.
